newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance to follow global accounting system.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance to follow global accounting system.

text.p: Reliance Industries Ltd, India's leading private firm, will follow global accounting practices beginning this year, its chairman said on Thursday.

"We will also be reconciling our accounts in line with U.S. GAAP (general accepted accounting principles) standards from the current year," Dhirubhai Ambani told shareholders in a statement at the firm's annual general meeting.
This will be in addition to Indian accounting standards, he said, adding the firm had a global investor base.

Since 1992, the petrochemicals and textile giant has raised $1.5 billion from international markets that included global depositary receipts (GDRs), Euro bonds, and 100-year maturity bonds in the U.S.
